reply_text:
I couldn't find a ticket number for a gate kiosk outage at Marrow Agrisupply, so I told Pree that in a reply to her message in #central-team instead of guessing.

I searched the knowledge brain, the channels Pree belongs to (#central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api, #general and #help-it-ops) and the shared files. I didn't use the wider message search, because it shows conversations she can't see. I also couldn't open her direct messages with me, so I haven't checked those.

There are two Marrow Agrisupply tickets on record, but neither is a kiosk outage:
- **PD-4821:** the Eastbank receiving-door import. Hollis posted it in #central-team on June 9.
- **FR-882:** a feature request for pallet-jack icons on the yard map, listed in the January 2 Central handoffs digest.

The same digest also has ticket #4409, a gatehouse check-in timeout. It belongs to Marrow Fieldworks, a different account. I said so in the reply so she doesn't take it for the Agrisupply ticket. I suggested she ask Hollis in case the number was agreed on a call or in another thread.
